removed_values.bev_blocked_by: refc_v3.RefCV3Model.forward does not pass `bev_tokens=` to self.core(...), and the BEV encoder (model._perception) runs AFTER the core forward on out['fmap_s16'] — so no BEV token exists at refc.py:4154 where the scene hook fires. Arms built today are AGENT-ONLY and must be reported as such.

added_values.bev_unblocked_by: PI RULING 2026-09-17 (SPEC_REFCV6_V2.md, items 15/18 CLOSED): the BEV encoder moved INTO the model forward (refc_v3.RefCV3Model._bev_hook -> refc.py's `bev_hook` seam), so a BEV token exists where the scene hook fires. An arm with d_bev 0 is still AGENT-ONLY and must be reported as such.
